result.title: Generative Structure from Motion with Native 3D Diffusion
result.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/
result.summary: Recovering an object's 3D structure and camera motion from a few uncalibrated views is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Classical structure from motion methods recover 3D geometry consistent with the input images but cannot recover unseen regions; native generation methods produce plausible 3D objects which are related but not necessarily faithful to the input images. Methods simply concatenating reconstruction and generation allow error to cascade across the two stages, instead of producing a 3D object consistent with both the distribution and the input. We propose GenSfM, which integrates image-based 3D reconstruction with a native 3D diffusion model. In particular, we use a multi-modal diffusion transformer to jointly denoise the shape latent and per-view pose latents under shared self-attention, grounding generated geometry in the observed views while using object-level priors to infer unobserved regions. A compact 3D-native UV-volume tokenization keeps the joint sequence small as views are added, and a pose-aware stage refines geometry and texture by sampling per-voxel image features at the recovered camera poses. On Toys4k and GSO, for $4$ uncalibrated views, GenSfM improves novel-view PSNR by $3.2$-$4.5$ dB and reduces median Chamfer distance by $2.8$-$3.8\times$ over a strong native-3D generation baseline, while recovering input-view poses over $96\%$ Acc@$5^\circ$ without any external pose-estimation backbone, post-hoc optimization, or known intrinsics. Project page: https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/.

AI.brief_summary: GenSfM 将基于图像的 3D 重建与原生 3D 扩散模型结合，用多模态扩散 Transformer 在共享自注意力下联合去噪形状 latent 与逐视角姿态 latent，从少量未标定视图恢复物体几何与相机运动。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「观测视图 grounding + 物体级先验补全未观测区域」的联合 latent 去噪机制，可供核查 LVR 中生成先验与视觉证据如何在同一状态内混合，但与视觉推理场景距离较远，迁移价值需进一步判断。
